[P2] Retain nonfatal delivery failures across owned cleanup

When the handler returns normally but result serialization throws `IllegalStateException`, `originalFailure` is null and the error exists only in `completedRoot`. This condition ignores it. If owned shutdown also throws, `DurableExecutor.execute()` throws the cleanup failure without retaining the serializer error as a cause or suppressed exception, hiding the original delivery failure. Include nonfatal completion errors when combining cleanup diagnostics while preserving fatal/cutoff precedence, and add a regression covering serialization failure followed by failing owned shutdown.
